notes: Confirmed. For nonnull records, the body validates the current 16-bit selector, may update the nested entry selector at +0x24, then clears the +0x19c byte, resets the +0x152 selector to 0xffff, and zeros the 32-bit value at +0x14c. Caller invokes it during record cleanup before forwarding a sentinel selector. The reset/selection-state wording is supported.

Confirmed. The body gathers three values from the global storyline object, reads the final nested value at +8, obtains additional event state, then passes the gathered values and input payload to f_7000df3eec, the accepted handle_storyline_moment_failed_selection_event routine. A direct caller routes its payload through this helper. The name describes this event preparation without claiming meanings for the global fields.

Confirmed conservatively. The body constructs candidate-validation flags from the supplied selector/status arguments, prepares a 0x2a30-byte temporary area, calls the candidate-check helper f_70006b6900, then calls f_70006b6c10 with the original context values and temporary results. A caller consumes the returned value as a count/validity threshold. This supports the generic validation label.

Confirmed. When the record byte at +0x428 is zero, selector 0 must yield status 1; the function then resolves an entry and requires its 16-bit flags to intersect 0x6. It returns -2 on failed gates, preserves signed inputs 0..15, returns 16 for inputs above 15, and rejects negative inputs with -2. The caller converts a float to signed integer, calls this helper, then stores its result.

Confirmed. This sibling body matches 0x7000f9d644: it conditionally requires selector 0 status 1, resolves an entry whose 16-bit flags intersect 0x6, returns -2 on failed conditions or negative input, preserves 0..15, and maps values above 15 to 16. Its caller converts a float to signed integer before calling and stores the returned index/status.
